tips.text: Radshare the Rare Systems relic at Radiant and run the other three relics in public squads.
Refine only the Systems relic; Radiant on the Chassis relic lowers its Common odds from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Check that every radshare member brought a Radiant relic before launch; an Intact squad wastes the 100 Void Traces.
Find vaulted radshares in the Vaulted Relic Community Discord, since recruit chat rarely has them.
Filter recruit chat by the exact relic name to cut the noise.
Do not force-start the next fissure before every squadmate has picked a relic; they get only Void Traces.
Collect 10 Reactant before extraction; a relic with less does not open.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you get the same item and they get extra Void Traces.
Buy extra Systems relics; every one carries it as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Bank only the Aya you need; relics cost 1 Aya each, and Void Traces for Radiant are the bigger cost.
Start the components in the Foundry the moment you have them; the frame build takes 3 days after the 12-hour parts.
When his rotation is live this is about an hour of Aya bounties and one radshare session for Systems; the wait for his rotation is the pain.
Opinion on the Prime is lukewarm: most call its gains over base Nekros small and say to wait for Resurgence rather than rush.
